title.zh: v2.13.0 MCP 服务：让其它 LLM 与 agent 用上曲风库、音序器、导出与测量
title.en: v2.13.0 An MCP Server: the Genre Library, the Sequencer, the Exporters and the Measurements, for Other LLMs and Agents

highlights.zh: **新增 MCP 服务：19 个工具、4 个 resource、3 个 prompt，其它 LLM 与 agent 可以直接用 Groove Lab。** 能检索 159 个曲风、读取曲风的**已记录事实**（年代、产地、文化背景、节奏特征、音色设计、制作提示、代表曲目、雷达指标、混音与响度修剪）、据此用**具名操作**写 pattern、导出 MIDI 与 Ableton 工程、生成分享链接，并用 App 自己的引擎渲染真实 WAV/MP3。一条命令跑起来：`npm run mcp:build && npm run mcp`。
highlights.en: **New MCP server: 19 tools, 4 resources and 3 prompts, so other LLMs and agents can use Groove Lab directly.** Search the 159 genres, read a genre's **recorded facts** (era, origin, cultural context, rhythm features, sound design, production tips, representative tracks, radar metrics, mix and loudness trim), compose a pattern with **named operations**, export MIDI and Ableton projects, build a share link, and render real WAV/MP3 through the app's own engine. One command to r…

highlights.zh: **它之所以能在 Node 里跑，是因为这个仓库的曲风库本来就是数据。** 159 个曲风、它们的 pattern、混音表、和弦走向、关系图谱与大师课都在 `src/data/**`，不依赖 DOM；MIDI 与 Ableton 是字节/XML 级 JS、分享是 base64、响度报告是已提交的实测表。所以**浏览、作曲、导出、分享完全不需要浏览器**。
highlights.en: **It runs in Node because this repository's library is data.** The 159 genres, their patterns, mix tables, chord progressions, relation graph and masterclasses live under `src/data/**` with no DOM dependency; MIDI and Ableton are byte/XML-level JS, sharing is base64, and the loudness report is the committed measurement table. **Browsing, composing, exporting and sharing therefore need no browser at all.**

highlights.zh: **只有"出声音"真的需要浏览器**：`render_audio` 会在第一次调用时**惰性**启动 Vite dev server 与无头 Chromium（冷启动约 40 秒，之后每次渲染几秒），并驱动 App 真实的 `renderPatternOffline`——和导出按钮用的是同一段代码，所以拿到的是**这个 App 的声音**，而不是第二套实现。`GROOVE_MCP_NO_BROWSER=1` 可以关掉它，其它工具照常工作。
highlights.en: **Only making sound genuinely needs a browser.** `render_audio` starts a Vite dev server and headless Chromium **lazily** on first use (~40 s cold, then seconds per render) and drives the app's real `renderPatternOffline` — the same code the export button uses, so what comes back is **this app's audio**, not a second implementation of it. `GROOVE_MCP_NO_BROWSER=1` refuses instead, and every other tool keeps working.
